Welcome to
Abene Property LLC

We provide year round property maintenance 

Since 2012, our team has worked throughout NW Chicago, Park Ridge, Des Plaines, Niles and surrounding suburbs everyday to provide consistent, trustworthy, professional and quality services for our clients. We offer all of your landscaping and outdoor property maintenance needs. Rest assured, you can count on us for year round property maintenance- from lawn care to snow removal and all landscape services and maintenance in between and throughout all 4 seasons. Feel free to get in touch today to receive a free estimate! 

More About Us & The Services We Offer

Since our beginning, Abene Property LLC has been known for quality service, efficiency, attention to detail and taking absolute pride in our work. We offer a wide variety of services from Lawn Mowing, to Lawn maintenance, fertilizer program, sod installation, plant-tree-bush planting, garden bed design, drainage solutions, patio installation, patio restoration, power washing, sealing and staining, gutter cleaning, window washing, tree trimming, tree and bush removal, spring and fall cleanups, leaf removals, snow removal, residential and commercial services, planning, planting and landscape design, mulch, rock dirt installation, bobcat services.

Our team is skilled, experienced and up for every job. Communication is key in this business, rest assured we have all English speaking reception and laborers, this leaves no grey area. Please get in touch to learn more about our team, our company or for details about the services we provide.
